programs.title: Heartbeat
programs.desc: Lord Ashfordly holds a Christmas Ball for the entire village to celebrate his recent marriage.  His new bride charms everyone completely, but all is not well at Ashfordly Hall when the new couple find themselves the victim of a series of disturbing hijackings.  When Mike goes undercover as the chauffeur he discovers the truth behind the attacks is closer to home than anyone thinks. When David has an car accident in the van, Vernon has to borrow the hearse for his annual Christmas tree orders. Mike's early Christmas gift to Tricia wasn't quite what she expected.

programs.title: Foyle's War
programs.desc: The death of a conscientious objector in police custody and the booby-trap murder of a young evacuee at the home of Gascoigne, the tribunal judge who had him arrested, leads Foyle and Milner to suspect someone is out for revenge. Could the death of the evacuee be a smokescreen for a maze of family conflict and prejudice against pacifists? And what is the real work of the secret wartime factory nearby?
